Agent Name: Planner

Step Number: 6

Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that "The Nice Guys has the director born first" when comparing the birth years of Shane Black (1961) and Peter Del Monte (1943). The error lies in the misunderstanding of the task requirement, which was to determine which film has the director who was born first. Since 1943 is earlier than 1961, Piccoli Fuochi has the director who was born first, not The Nice Guys. The Planner should have stated that Piccoli Fuochi was directed by the director born first.
